class.name: SuperposReplicaView
class.brief_description: Immutable weak view of one received canonical replica.
class.description: Returned by [method SuperposSpawner.get_replicas]. It cannot be constructed directly. The view reads the receiver's canonical image through the shared typed decoder and never indexes the authoritative World. It holds only a weak Session identity, the receiver binding generation, the full handle and the complete replica key. After stop, detach, reattachment, incarnation reuse, ownership encoding reset or migration, an old view stays stale and every call returns an error, even when wire replica keys are reused. All calls are main-thread and owner-thread only.

method.name: call_rpc
method.description: Sends the registered schema RPC [param rpc_id] for this replica to the authority over the receiver's RPC channel. The replica must be canonical-ready and its schema must declare the RPC; [param payload] may not exceed the declared maximum. A client is never the authority, so an Authority-permission RPC returns [constant ERR_UNAUTHORIZED], and an Owner-permission RPC returns it unless this peer owns the replica. The call carries the observed ownership revision; the authority authorizes it again when gameplay takes it. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] while eight sends are still awaiting delivery, and [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] for an undeclared RPC.

method.name: get_binding_generation
method.description: Returns the unsigned receiver binding generation this view was created for.

method.name: get_handle
method.description: Returns the full unsigned object handle of the replica.

method.name: read_fields
method.description: Decodes the listed registered field IDs from the current canonical image. On success the Dictionary contains [code]error[/code], [code]values[/code] keyed by field ID, [code]revision[/code], [code]owner[/code], [code]ownership_revision[/code], [code]canonical_ready[/code], [code]binding_generation[/code], [code]handle[/code] and [code]tick[/code] (the authoritative publication tick of this image). Unknown or duplicate IDs return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. A stale view returns another [enum Error] code.

method.name: read_status
method.description: Returns [code]error[/code], [code]canonical_ready[/code], [code]revision[/code], [code]binding_generation[/code], [code]handle[/code] and, while the spawner runtime is attached, [code]scene[/code]. The [code]scene[/code] Dictionary reports [code]scene_phase[/code] ([code]"pending"[/code], [code]"ready"[/code], [code]"failed"[/code] or [code]"retiring"[/code]), [code]completed_fields[/code], [code]projection_error[/code], [code]projected_revision[/code] and [code]spawn_timed_out[/code]. A replica whose initial state missed the spawn readiness timeout reports the failed phase with [code]spawn_timed_out[/code] set. Canonical readiness and scene projection are reported separately.

method.name: retry_projection
method.description: Requeues a failed scene projection for a canonical-ready replica, including one held after a spawn readiness timeout. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] when the projection is not in the failed phase or a projection is running, and an error for a stale view.
